items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: So soon enough, I went on and I played a whole lot of jobs with him.

ctx.x: That was the Vega? That was the Vega banjo.
No, that was an Orpian banjo, it was called. Orpian banjo. So I bought that banjo and after I got that banjo, there was a trumpet player, his name was White, Amos White.
